name: papers_search
description: Search AutoPaper using keywords and a semantic description, with optional venues, year range, similarity threshold and auto_ingest. AutoPaper may fetch and ingest online papers when local results are insufficient; omit auto_ingest to use its upstream default (currently true), or set false to search stored papers only. Returns ranked papers, summaries, links and a search session ID. Persists search history and may add papers; do not blindly retry uncertain outcomes. Defaults: top_k=50, min_similarity=0.5. At least keywords or a nonblank description is required.
